title: Reverse upstream what the switch sent, when a terminal reverses

blocks.text: Another acquirer joins the switch. Its terminals don't send field 90: a reversal names the purchase it undoes by the terminal's ID (41) and the retrieval reference number (37) the terminal gave the purchase. Each terminal makes its RRN from the date and its own counter. The fuel-card network behind the switch keeps an approved amount on the cardholder's account until a reversal it can match to the purchase arrives, and it ignores a reversal it can't match.

`src/main/java/com/example/practice/ReversalRecords.java` holds the participants of the forwarding group and of the reversal group, and the builder of the upstream reversal. Finish `remember` and `reverse`, marked `TODO`, so that a terminal's reversal frees the amount the network holds for the purchase. Something else sends what you put on the `reversal.<link>` queues. About ten lines in total.

The tests deploy a real TransactionManager, a real `QueryHost` and two real QMUXes with Q2, in the test's own JVM, with a network behind each QMUX that approves everything. They look at what the switch queued for each network and at what it keeps between a purchase and its reversal.

cases.says: a terminal's reversal of an approved purchase is answered 00 and leaves one reversal for the network
a reversal of a purchase the switch never forwarded is answered 00 and sends nothing upstream
the upstream reversal names, in field 90, the STAN and time of the message the network received, not the terminal's
a reversal and its repeat leave one reversal for the network, because the record is taken, not read
the record kept for a reversal holds no track data, PIN block or chip data, although the network was sent them
two terminals that give their purchases the same RRN each get their own purchase reversed

origin.section: 16.2 A Source's Reversal Finds What the Destination Saw Only Through the Switch's Record

concepts: The record is taken, not read, so a repeated reversal goes upstream once, and it is kept without track data, PIN block or chip data.

A source's reversal names the source's original, which the destination never saw; the switch finds the upstream message through its own record and reverses that, so field 90 names what the destination received.
